description: Delete all reactions for one specified emoji on a message across every user who reacted. To remove every emoji reaction at once, use discord_delete_all_message_reactions; to remove only the bot's own reaction, use discord_delete_my_message_reaction. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History, Manage Messages. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread holding the message

emoji.description: Emoji as a Unicode character ('👍') or its URL-encoded form ('%F0%9F%91%8D'), or a custom emoji as name:id ('party_blob:123456789012345678')

message_id.description: ID of the message to target
